report_note: Tests whether low-sleep context surfaces in the narrative guidance.

preference_notes: I want better energy and appetite control.

response.calorie_rationale: Use ~2150 kcal as a practical midpoint between the 2000 and 2200 kcal serving rows and close to estimated TDEE (2130 kcal). For appetite control and steadier energy, keep meals balanced rather than low-calorie or snack-heavy.
response.meal_pattern: 3 meals + 1 planned snack daily; aim for protein + fiber at each meal, and make the snack protein-forward instead of sugary or salty packaged foods.
foods_to_prioritize: lean meats, eggs, Greek yogurt, milk, tofu, soy foods, beans, lentils
whole grains like oats, brown rice, whole-wheat bread, quinoa
foods_to_avoid: sugar-sweetened beverages, energy drinks, fruit drinks, soda
foods with lots of added sugar or artificial sweeteners
response.sleep_note: 5 hours of sleep can increase hunger and snack cravings, so keep meal timing consistent and avoid relying on caffeine or sugary drinks for energy.
response.summary: Your calorie target is about 2150 kcal, which matches your estimated energy needs and should support better energy without pushing intake too low. For appetite control, build meals around protein, whole grains, vegetables, fruit, and healthy fats, and plan one protein-rich snack. Limit sugary drinks and highly processed snacks, since they can worsen cravings. Improving sleep will likely help hunger and energy the most.
